neighboring_unit_entries.title: Changing the smoothing shape preserves the Gram cost unless the parameter scales with s
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The conclusion compares exponential and complementary-error-function choices, explains why the Berry-Keating logarithmic cutoff remains square-root length, identifies a transition from order-one to s-dependent parameters as open, and attributes remainder-bound failure to crude loss of oscillation.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Product and integral representations establish the gamma-ratio monotonicities used by the remainder estimate
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: A gamma-product logarithmic derivative proves F is even and increasing above a parameter threshold; scaling removes its power growth, and an integral-kernel sign argument proves G decreases in the stated analytic range, with numerical computation suggesting a wider range.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Appendix A proves the generalized expansion really contains the earlier critical-line formula, while Appendix B supplies the monotonicity properties invoked to bound the remainder, connecting representation consistency and error control back to the main construction.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The appendix formulas require original-page reconstruction, and the numerically wider monotonicity range is not proved.
related_synthesis_entries.title: The appendices close two hidden dependencies of the main argument

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: A specialized parameter choice is checked by tracking pole cancellation, reflecting the remaining contour, and recovering the known two-sided incomplete-gamma expansion through analytic continuation.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: With a=s/2 and p=1, trivial zeta zeros cancel most gamma poles, leaving one residue. The functional equation and variable reflection identify the remainder with a companion smoothed sum; absolute convergence permits analytic continuation, and a critical-line K choice recovers formula (1.4).
directed.conceptual_reading: Consistency is established structurally rather than by term matching: the singularities, reflection symmetry, and continuation determine how the general representation collapses to the earlier one.
directed.representation_or_bridge: Pole-zero cancellation and the zeta functional equation bridge the generalized one-sided contour expansion to a symmetric pair of incomplete-gamma sums.
directed.boundary_or_failure: This appendix validates a specialization but does not show a new cost or accuracy advantage.
directed.uncertainty: Equations (A.1)-(A.4) are severely corrupted in the text layer, so exact parameters and factors require the scan.
